# Preparing the data for model training

```{r}
source("R/functions_training.R")

train_model <- function(radar, season, year_held_out = NULL) {
  task <- create_task(radar, season = season)
  
  selected_features_file <- sprintf("data/raw/model_features/fs_selected_top_features_%s_%s_dynamic.RDS", radar, season)
  train_features <- readRDS(selected_features_file)
  task$select(train_features)
  
  learner <- lrn("regr.lightgbm", 
                 objective = "tweedie",
                 verbose = 2,
                 num_threads = 10)
  best_params <- readRDS(sprintf("data/raw/model_params/fs_twdie_%s_%s_dynamic_regr.rmse_best_params_regr.rmse.RDS", radar,
                                 season))
  best_params$num_threads <- parallel::detectCores()-1
  learner$param_set$values <- best_params
  
  if (!is.null(year_held_out)) {
    tic(paste0("Training model for ", radar, " ", season, " ", year_held_out))
    row_ids <- which(task$groups$group != year_held_out)
    learner$train(task, row_ids = row_ids)
    toc()
    return(list(learner = learner, task = task, year_held_out = year_held_out, 
                row_ids = row_ids))
  } else {
    tic(paste0("Training model for ", radar, " ", season))
    learner$train(task)
    toc()
    return(list(learner = learner, task = task))
  }
}

model_autumn <- train_model("nlhrw", "autumn")
model_spring <- train_model("nlhrw", "spring")
```

```{r}
additional_cols <- c("year", "datetime", "period_rank_mtr", "night_num", "mt")

# data_autumn <- create_task("nlhrw", "autumn")
selected_features_autumn <- sprintf("data/raw/model_features/fs_selected_top_features_%s_%s_dynamic.RDS", "nlhrw", "autumn")
selected_features_spring <- sprintf("data/raw/model_features/fs_selected_top_features_%s_%s_dynamic.RDS", "nlhrw", "spring")
train_features_autumn <- readRDS(selected_features_autumn)
train_features_spring <- readRDS(selected_features_spring)

data_autumn <- create_task("nlhrw", "autumn")$data(cols = c(train_features_autumn, additional_cols)) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())

data_spring <- create_task("nlhrw", "spring")$data(cols = c(train_features_spring, additional_cols)) %>%
      mutate(row_id = row_number())

for (year_held_out in 2017:2024) {
    print(paste0("Year held out: ", year_held_out))
    
    tic("Calculating autumn SHAP values")
    model_autumn <- train_model("nlhrw", "autumn", year_held_out = year_held_out)
    sv_autumn <- shapviz(model_autumn$learner$model, 
                         data_autumn %>% select(all_of(model_autumn$task$feature_names)) %>% as.matrix())
    toc()
    saveRDS(sv_autumn, file = paste0("data/processed/sv_autumn_", year_held_out, ".RDS"))
    
    tic("Calculating spring SHAP values")
    model_spring <- train_model("nlhrw", "spring", year_held_out = year_held_out)
    sv_spring <- shapviz(model_spring$learner$model, 
                         data_spring %>% select(all_of(model_spring$task$feature_names)) %>% as.matrix())
    toc()
    saveRDS(sv_spring, file = paste0("data/processed/sv_spring_", year_held_out, ".RDS"))
}
```

```{r}
  #                  breaks = c("Good night", "Top night"),
  #                  name = "Peak night", na.value = "#00000000") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = midnight_breaks,
                   label = function(x) {
                     dt <- as.POSIXct(sub(" UTC$", "", x), tz = "UTC")

  facet_wrap(vars(month(datetime_posix)), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "right")
```

```{r}
vars <- c(colnames(sv_spring), colnames(sv_autumn))

classify_var_location <- function(v) {
  if (str_detect(v, "rdr_")) return("Radar-level")
  if (str_detect(v, "fl_")) return("En-route")
  if (str_detect(v, "stp_")) return("Stopover")
  if (v %in% c("yday", "solar_elev", "solar_azim", "solar_elevation_change")) return("Phenology")
  if (v == "height") return("Height")
  if (v == "nr_birds") return("Radar-level")
}

classify_var_envir <- function(v) {
  if (str_detect(v, "_u|_v")) return("Wind")
  if (str_detect(v, "_t|_t2m")) return("Temperature")
  if (str_detect(v, "_lsrr|_crr")) return("Precipitation")
  if (str_detect(v, "_msl")) return("Pressure")
  if (str_detect(v, "_blh")) return("Boundary layer height")
  if (str_detect(v, "_cc|_lcc|_mcc|_hcc|_cbh")) return("Cloud cover")
  if (str_detect(v, "_r|_q")) return("Humidity")
  if (str_detect(v, "_lsm")) return("Land-sea mask")
  if (v == "height") return("Height")
  if (v == "yday") return("Day of year")
  if (str_detect(v, "solar_")) return("Time of night")
  if (str_detect(v, "_lat|_lon")) return("Take-off location")
  if (v == "nr_birds") return("Nr. of birds")
}

var_locations <- vapply(vars, classify_var_location, character(1))
var_envir <- vapply(vars, classify_var_envir, character(1))

var_combined <- paste(var_locations, var_envir)

collapse_locations <- split(vars, var_locations)
collapse_locations <- lapply(collapse_locations, unique)

collapse_envir <- split(vars, var_envir)
collapse_envir <- lapply(collapse_envir, unique)

spring_collapsed_locations <- collapse_shap(sv_spring$S, collapse_locations)
autumn_collapsed_locations <- collapse_shap(sv_autumn$S, collapse_locations)

spring_collapsed_envir <- collapse_shap(sv_spring$S, collapse_envir)
autumn_collapsed_envir <- collapse_shap(sv_autumn$S, collapse_envir)

merged_shap_data_spring <- left_join(sv_spring$X, data_spring_shap)
merged_shap_data_autumn <- left_join(sv_autumn$X, data_autumn_shap)

spring_collapsed_locations %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(merged_shap_data_spring) %>%
  mutate(season = "Spring") %>%
  identity() -> spring_shap_locations

autumn_collapsed_locations %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(merged_shap_data_autumn) %>%
  mutate(season = "Autumn") %>%
  identity() -> autumn_shap_locations

spring_collapsed_envir %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(merged_shap_data_spring) %>%
  mutate(season = "Spring") %>%
  identity() -> spring_shap_envir

autumn_collapsed_envir %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(merged_shap_data_autumn) %>%
  mutate(season = "Autumn") %>%
  identity() -> autumn_shap_envir

bind_rows(spring_shap_locations, autumn_shap_locations) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `En-route`:`Stopover`, names_to = "location", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
  filter(!location == "Height") %>%
  identity() -> location_shap

bind_rows(spring_shap_envir, autumn_shap_envir) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Boundary layer height`:`Wind`, names_to = "envir", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
  filter(!envir == "Height") %>%
  identity() -> envir_shap


# The plots below are the story!
ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = period_rank_mtr, y = SHAP, color = season), 
             data = location_shap %>% group_by(season, location) %>% slice_sample(n = 5000),
             alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = period_rank_mtr, y = SHAP, color = season), data = location_shap %>% group_by(season, location) %>% slice_sample(n = 50000)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(location), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Night rank", y = "Summed SHAP")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = period_rank_mtr, y = SHAP, color = season), 
             data = envir_shap %>% group_by(season, envir) %>% slice_sample(n = 5000),
             alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = period_rank_mtr, y = SHAP, color = season), data = envir_shap %>% group_by(season, envir) %>% slice_sample(n = 10000)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(envir), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Night rank", y = "Summed SHAP")
# The plots above are the story!

ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = yday, y = SHAP, color = season), 
             data = location_shap %>% group_by(season, location) %>% slice_sample(n = 5000),
             alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = yday, y = SHAP, color = season), data = location_shap %>% group_by(season, location) %>% slice_sample(n = 50000)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(location), scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Day of year", y = "Summed SHAP")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = yday, y = SHAP, color = season), 
             data = envir_shap %>% group_by(season, envir) %>% slice_sample(n = 5000),
             alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = yday, y = SHAP, color = season), data = envir_shap %>% group_by(season, envir) %>% slice_sample(n = 10000)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(envir), scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Day of year", y = "Summed SHAP")
```

```{r}
yearmonths <- expand.grid(year = c(2017:2024), month = c(8:11)) %>% purrr::transpose()

vars <- colnames(sva)

classify_var <- function(v) {
  if (str_detect(v, "rdr_")) return("Radar-level")
  if (str_detect(v, "fl_")) return("En-route")
  if (str_detect(v, "stp_")) return("Stopover")
  if (v %in% c("yday", "solar_elev", "solar_azim", "solar_elevation_change")) return("Phenology")
  if (v == "height") return("Height")
  if (v == "nr_birds") return("Radar-level")
}

var_class <- vapply(vars, classify_var, character(1))

collapse <- split(vars, var_class)

S_collapsed <- collapse_shap(sva$S, collapse)

classify_var_envir <- function(v) {
  if (str_detect(v, "_u|_v")) return("Wind")
  if (str_detect(v, "_t|_t2m")) return("Temperature")
  if (str_detect(v, "_lsrr|_crr")) return("Precipitation")
  if (str_detect(v, "_msl")) return("Pressure")
  if (str_detect(v, "_blh")) return("Boundary layer height")
  if (str_detect(v, "_cc|_lcc|_mcc|_hcc|_cbh")) return("Cloud cover")
  if (str_detect(v, "_r|_q")) return("Humidity")
  if (str_detect(v, "_lsm")) return("Land-sea mask")
  if (v == "height") return("Height")
  if (v == "yday") return("Day of year")
  if (str_detect(v, "solar_")) return("Time of night")
  if (str_detect(v, "_lat|_lon")) return("Take-off location")
  if (v == "nr_birds") return("Nr. of birds")
}

var_class_envir <- vapply(vars, classify_var_envir, character(1))
collapse_envir <- split(vars, var_class_envir)
S_collapsed_envir <- collapse_shap(sva$S, collapse_envir)


var_label <- setNames(
  paste(var_class[names(var_class_envir)], var_class_envir, sep = " - "),
  names(var_class_envir)
)
collapse_label <- split(vars, var_label)
S_collapsed_label <- collapse_shap(sva$S, collapse_label)


data_plot <- task$data(cols = c("height", "period_rank_mtr", "year", "datetime")) %>%
  bind_cols(S_collapsed) %>%
  bind_cols(truth = task$truth(), pred = pred)

data_plot_envir <- task$data(cols = c("height", "period_rank_mtr", "year", "datetime")) %>%
  bind_cols(S_collapsed_envir) %>%
  bind_cols(truth = task$truth(), pred = pred)

data_plot_label <- task$data(cols = c("height", "period_rank_mtr", "year", "datetime")) %>%
  bind_cols(S_collapsed_label) %>%
  bind_cols(truth = task$truth(), pred = pred)

for (yearmonth in yearmonths) {
  midnight_breaks <- data_plot_label %>%
  filter(year == yearmonth$year) %>%
  # filter(month(datetime) == yearmonth$month) %>%
  filter(hour(datetime) == 0, minute(datetime) == 0) %>%
  distinct(datetime) %>%
  pull(datetime) %>%
  as.character()

data_plot %>%
  filter(year == yearmonth$year) %>%
  # filter(lubridate::month(datetime) == yearmonth$month) %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.factor(datetime)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime)) +
  geom_tile(aes(y = height, fill = truth)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt", option = "magma",  na.value = 0, name = "Bird dens.") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = midnight_breaks,
                   label = function(x) format(as.POSIXct(sub(" UTC$", "", x), tz = "UTC"), "%b %-d"),
                   position = "top") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(#axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 1, vjust = -1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),) +
  labs(y = "Height [m]")-> vpts_truth

#         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
#         axis.title.x = element_blank()) -> vpts_pred

data_plot %>%
  filter(year == yearmonth$year) %>%
  # filter(lubridate::month(datetime) == yearmonth$month) %>%
  select(datetime, height, Height, `En-route`, Stopover, `Radar-level`, Phenology) %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.factor(datetime)) %>%
  # select(-c(height)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(datetime, height), names_to = "Factor", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
  filter(Factor != "Height") %>%
  mutate(Factor = fct_relevel(Factor, c("Radar-level", "En-route", "Stopover", "Phenology"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = height, fill = SHAP)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = "Berlin", mid = 0, p1 = 1, p2 = 1, l1 = 70, na.value = 0) + 
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = midnight_breaks,
                   label = function(x) format(as.POSIXct(sub(" UTC$", "", x), tz = "UTC"), "%b %-d")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank()) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Factor), ncol = 1) +
  labs(y = "Height [m]", x = "") -> shap_vpts

data_plot_envir %>%
  filter(year == yearmonth$year) %>%
  # filter(lubridate::month(datetime) == yearmonth$month) %>%
  select(datetime, height, Height, `Boundary layer height`, `Cloud cover`, `Day of year`, Humidity, `Land-sea mask`, `Nr. of birds`, Precipitation, Pressure, Temperature, `Time of night`, Wind) %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.factor(datetime)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(datetime, height), names_to = "Factor", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
  filter(!Factor %in% c("Height", "Day of year", "Humidity", "Land-sea mask", "Pressure", "Cloud cover")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = height, fill = SHAP)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = "Berlin", mid = 0, p1 = 1, p2 = 1, l1 = 70, na.value = 0) + 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = midnight_breaks,
                   label = function(x) format(as.POSIXct(sub(" UTC$", "", x), tz = "UTC"), "%b %-d")) +
  # dark_theme_gray() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank()) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Factor), ncol = 1) +
  labs(y = "Height [m]", x = "") -> shap_vpts_envir

data_plot_label %>%
  filter(year == yearmonth$year) %>%
  # filter(lubridate::month(datetime) == yearmonth$month) %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>%

  pivot_longer(cols = -c(datetime, height), names_to = "Factor", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
  filter(Factor != "Height") %>%
  mutate(Factor = fct_relevel(Factor, c("Stopover - Wind", "En-route - Wind", "Radar-level - Wind", "Stopover - Precipitation", "En-route - Precipitation"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = height, fill = SHAP)) +

  facet_wrap(vars(Factor), ncol = 1) +

      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),

  labs(y = "Height [m]", x = "") -> shap_vpts_labels
```
